After D, available: A, B, F. Choose smallest: A(2) vs F(2) vs B(5). Tie between A and F; lexicographically choose A before F. So second A.

After A, C becomes available. Available: B(5), C(3), F(2). Smallest: F(2). So third F.

After F, available: B(5), C(3). Smallest: C(3). So fourth C.

After C, no
